segments.ja504:1.1: Bhallātiyo [bhallāṭiyo (sī. pī.)] nāma ahosi rājā, raṭṭhaṃ pahāya migavaṃ acāri so;
segments.ja504:1.3: Agamā girivaraṃ gandhamādanaṃ, supupphitaṃ [sampupphitaṃ (sī. pī.)] kimpurisānuciṇṇaṃ.
segments.ja504:2.1: Sāḷūrasaṅghañca nisedhayitvā, dhanuṃ [dhanu (sī. syā. pī.)] kalāpañca so nikkhipitvā;
segments.ja504:2.3: Upāgami vacanaṃ vattukāmo, yatthaṭṭhitā kimpurisā ahesuṃ.
segments.ja504:3.1: Himaccaye hemavatāya tīre, kimidhaṭṭhitā mantayavho abhiṇhaṃ;
segments.ja504:3.3: Pucchāmi vo mānusadehavaṇṇe, kathaṃ nu [kathaṃ vo (sī. syā. pī.)] jānanti manussaloke.
segments.ja504:4.1: Mallaṃ giriṃ paṇḍarakaṃ tikūṭaṃ, sītodakā [sītodiyā (sī. pī.), sītodikā (?)] anuvicarāma najjo;
segments.ja504:4.3: Migā manussāva nibhāsavaṇṇā, jānanti no kimpurisāti ludda.
segments.ja504:5.1: Sukiccharūpaṃ paridevayavho [paridevathavho (?) moggallānabyākaraṇe 6.38 suttaṃ], āliṅgito cāsi piyo piyāya;
segments.ja504:5.3: Pucchāmi vo mānusadehavaṇṇe, kimidha vane rodatha appatītā.
segments.ja504:6.1: Sukiccharūpaṃ paridevayavho, āliṅgito cāsi piyo piyāya;
segments.ja504:6.3: Pucchāmi vo mānusadehavaṇṇe, kimidha vane vilapatha appatītā.
segments.ja504:7.1: Sukiccharūpaṃ paridevayavho, āliṅgito cāsi piyo piyāya;
segments.ja504:7.3: Pucchāmi vo mānusadehavaṇṇe, kimidha vane socatha appatītā.
segments.ja504:8.1: Mayekarattaṃ [rattiṃ (pī.)] vippavasimha ludda, akāmakā aññamaññaṃ sarantā;
segments.ja504:8.3: Tamekarattaṃ anutappamānā, socāma “sā ratti punaṃ na hessati”.
segments.ja504:9.1: Yamekarattaṃ anutappathetaṃ, dhanaṃ va naṭṭhaṃ pitaraṃ va petaṃ;
segments.ja504:9.3: Pucchāmi vo mānusadehavaṇṇe, kathaṃ vinā vāsamakappayittha.
segments.ja504:10.1: Yamimaṃ [yayimaṃ (ka. sī.)] nadiṃ passasi sīghasotaṃ, nānādumacchādanaṃ selakūlaṃ [dumacchadanaṃ selakūṭaṃ (sī. pī.), dumasañchannaṃ selakūlaṃ (ka.)];
segments.ja504:10.3: Taṃ me piyo uttari vassakāle, mamañca maññaṃ anubandhatīti.
segments.ja504:11.3: “Piyo ca me hehiti mālabhārī, ahañca naṃ mālinī ajjhupessaṃ”.
segments.ja504:12.1: Ahañcidaṃ kuravakamocināmi, uddālakā pāṭalisindhuvārakā [sindhuvāritā (syā. pī. ka.)];
segments.ja504:12.3: “Piyo ca me hehiti mālabhārī, ahañca naṃ mālinī ajjhupessaṃ”.
segments.ja504:13.1: Ahañca sālassa supupphitassa, oceyya pupphāni karomi mālaṃ;
segments.ja504:13.3: “Piyo ca me hehiti mālabhārī, ahañca naṃ mālinī ajjhupessaṃ”.
segments.ja504:14.1: Ahañca sālassa supupphitassa, oceyya pupphāni karomi bhāraṃ;
segments.ja504:14.3: Idañca no hehiti santharatthaṃ, yatthajjimaṃ [yatthajjamaṃ (sī. pī.)] viharissāma [viharissāmu (pī.)] rattiṃ.
segments.ja504:15.1: Ahañca kho agaḷuṃ [aggalu (syā. ka.), akaluṃ (pī.)] candanañca, silāya piṃsāmi pamattarūpā;
segments.ja504:15.3: “Piyo ca me hehiti rositaṅgo, ahañca naṃ rositā ajjhupessaṃ”.
segments.ja504:16.1: Athāgamā salilaṃ sīghasotaṃ, nudaṃ sāle salaḷe kaṇṇikāre;
segments.ja504:16.3: Āpūratha [apūratha (sī. pī.), āpūrathe (syā.)] tena muhuttakena, sāyaṃ nadī āsi mayā suduttarā.
segments.ja504:17.1: Ubhosu tīresu mayaṃ tadā ṭhitā, sampassantā ubhayo aññamaññaṃ;
segments.ja504:17.3: Sakimpi rodāma sakiṃ hasāma, kicchena no āgamā [agamā (sī. syā. pī.)] saṃvarī sā.
segments.ja504:18.1: Pātova [pāto ca (sī. syā. pī.)] kho uggate sūriyamhi, catukkaṃ nadiṃ uttariyāna ludda;
segments.ja504:18.3: Āliṅgiyā aññamaññaṃ mayaṃ ubho, sakimpi rodāma sakiṃ hasāma.
segments.ja504:19.1: Tīhūnakaṃ sattasatāni ludda, yamidha mayaṃ vippavasimha pubbe;
segments.ja504:19.3: Vassekimaṃ [vāsekimaṃ (sī. pī.)] jīvitaṃ bhūmipāla, ko nīdha kantāya vinā vaseyya.
segments.ja504:20.1: Āyuñca vo kīvatako nu samma, sacepi jānātha vadetha āyuṃ;
segments.ja504:20.3: Anussavā vuḍḍhato āgamā vā, akkhātha me taṃ avikampamānā.
segments.ja504:21.1: Āyuñca no vassasahassaṃ ludda, na cantarā pāpako atthi rogo;
segments.ja504:21.3: Appañca [appaṃva (syā. ka.)] dukkhaṃ sukhameva bhiyyo, avītarāgā vijahāma jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja504:22.1: Idañca sutvāna amānusānaṃ, bhallātiyo ittara jīvitanti;
segments.ja504:22.3: Nivattatha na migavaṃ acari, adāsi dānāni abhuñji bhoge.
segments.ja504:23.1: Idañca sutvāna amānusānaṃ, sammodatha mā kalahaṃ akattha;
segments.ja504:23.3: Mā vo tapī attakammāparādho, yathāpi te kimpurisekarattaṃ.
segments.ja504:24.1: Idañca sutvāna amānusānaṃ, sammodatha mā vivādaṃ akattha;
segments.ja504:24.3: Mā vo tapī attakammāparādho, yathāpi te kimpurisekarattaṃ.
segments.ja504:25.1: Vividhaṃ [vividha (sī. syā.)] adhimanā suṇomahaṃ, vacanapathaṃ tava atthasaṃhitaṃ;
segments.ja504:25.3: Muñcaṃ [muñca (sī. pī.)] giraṃ nudaseva me daraṃ, samaṇa sukhāvaha jīva me ciranti.
